checks.q: Taking all the evidence: real product, honest meme, or LARP?
checks.title: AI verdict

evidence.v: Name "Rex Robinhood Agent" implies an AI agent affiliated with Robinhood — No description, no GitHub, and the website returns 404; no agent or affiliation is shown anywhere.
Linked X post implies official Robinhood backing — The X link is a post by @RobinhoodApp ("rex is ready to cook"), a different account. That is borrowed narrative, not proof of affiliation.
Project website — The j7m.io short link returns HTTP 404 "Object not found". It shows no contract address and no mention of Robinhood.
Name uses the Robinhood brand; Robinhood Chain has no native token
X link points to an @RobinhoodApp post, not the project's own account
Token launched about 4 minutes after that post, suggesting it rides the news
Website is a link shortener that resolves to a 404 storage bucket
No description, GitHub, Telegram or Discord

checks.summary: LARP: "Robinhood Agent" token with a dead shortened website and a borrowed @RobinhoodApp post; no evidence of an agent or affiliation.
